description: Roof extension, solar panels and AC unit
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ffcfb4e1-7fff-e385-2f42-7189cc542a1c"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development, by reason of its unacceptable design, scale and form, disrupts the existing architectural integrity of the host building, detrimental to the character and appearance of the host building and the wider area. Therefore, the proposal does not meet the requirements of London Plan policy D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), and Hackney Local Plan policy LP1 (Design quality and local character).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-dcb9317a-7fff-a377-17d7-0d458340d860"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">In the absence of a noise impact assessment, the proposed development fails to&nbsp; demonstrate that the nearest sensitive receptors would not be impacted by the proposed a/c unit in terms of noise and disturbance.&nbsp; Therefore, the proposed development would fail to accord with policy D14 (Noise) of The London Plan and LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2020.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-0b84c997-7fff-ccc9-0701-bc15226b81d6"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed development has failed to adhere to the cooling hierarchy&nbsp;and no details on passive overheating mitigations have been considered. Therefore, it is considered that the proposed development would be contrary to LP33 policy LP55 (Mitigating Climate Change) and policies Sl2 (Minimising Greenhouse Gas Emissions) and Sl4 (Managing Heat Risk) of The London Plan.</span></p>
